body:
Hi @aymeric-giraudet
I understand your point of view. Maybe this escape feature could be configurable (opt-in or opt-out) to avoid duplicating the connectToggleFilter code ?

As for the `Configure` solution we tried it but we encounter the following behavior.
Imagine a page with a toggleRefinement where `on` value is '5'.
Off value is not set because negative filter is not possible, so we instantiate a `Configure` node that take the negative filter in properties when `isRefined = false`.

1. User arrive on the page, checkbox is not checked, query is sent with negative filter from `Configure`
2. User check the box, toggleRefinement `refine` is executed but `Configure` will only dismount on next rerender.
So, query is sent with both `on` and `off` value.
3. Configure node is dismounted from the DOM, another query is sent with `on` value only

This result is two query sent when checkbox is checked, instead of one.
